_about: Isolation-barrier ratings transcribed from each part's manufacturer datasheet (the catalog datasheet_url). Every entry quotes the datasheet text it came from; tests/test_parts_graph.py checks each quote still appears in that datasheet. Values are the package/ordering code listed, not the family maximum. '>' and 'min' bounds are stored as the bound. mopp is set only when the datasheet states a MOPP count that applies to this package.

_not_transcribed.ADUM1201ARZ-JSM: JSMSEMI second-source datasheet has no insulation table.
_not_transcribed.FN1-24S12H6: Datasheet link is a 121-page multi-product catalog; values cannot be attributed to this part.
_not_transcribed.EL817(C)-F: Datasheet PDF text could not be extracted.
